intent.proves: No paragraph is bound to a grid row on another page.
intent.scope: non-deleted paragraphs with a grid row; complete enumeration

bindings.reason: Tool is scoped to one area or page; a handler must enumerate every area/page and aggregate, which mcp-count does not do.

bindings.query: SELECT TOP 25 CAST(x.ParagraphId AS nvarchar(20)) + N' row ' + CAST(g.GridRowId AS nvarchar(20)) FROM Paragraph x JOIN GridRow g ON g.GridRowId = x.ParagraphGridRowId WHERE x.ParagraphDeleted = 0 AND g.GridRowPageId <> x.ParagraphPageId
